newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania flood death toll four, farm land submerged.
newsitem.headline: Romania flood death toll four, farm land submerged.

text.p: The death toll in a week of flooding and heavy rain throughout Romania rose to four on Thursday and officials forecast fresh difficulties with rain still falling in mountain areas.
The environment ministry said a mother and her six-year-old daughter died in the southern county of Gorj, carried off after seeking shelter under a bridge.
A man died in the central county of Hunedoara, and another was killed in the first series of floods last week near the border with ex-Soviet Moldova.
Most of Romania basked in hot, sunny weather, but the ministry said two rivers remained at flood stage and reported inceased damage to farmland.
It said the River Olt, which bisects Romania, had spilled over onto more than 3,200 hectares (7,900 Acres) of farm land, in areas with no dikes.

Earlier reports indicated more than 1,000 hectares of crop land had been submerged. The Agriculture Ministry has acknowledged that a forecast bumper wheat crop will be subject to delays but has issued no estimates of crop damage.
More than 1,200 families have been evacuated.

Weather forecasters said water pouring down mountainsides soaked from continuing rainfall could push a number of small rivers over flooding levels. The River Danube remained well below flood levels with no significant rises expected.
